{{Quote|Avan, it says here you're from Illodia, but the Beruss family is well known on Corellia. You ''are'' related to Doman Beruss, our rep on the Provisional Council? ''"<br />"''Sir, she is my great aunt, the Corellian Berusses are a branch of an Illodian family. My father is also named Doman Beruss, after an ancestor.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Avan Beruss]]|<ref name="RS21" />}}
'''Doman Beruss''' was a member of [[Clan Beruss]]. The [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Doman Beruss (Illodian)|Doman Beruss]] of [[Illodia]] was named after this ancestor.<ref name="RS21" /> The female senator [[Doman Beruss (Corellian)|Doman Beruss]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] was also given her older relative's name out of respect.<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
